title: 第十九章 蛟珠炼身携武归府风云起第二十章 武威慑众一语戳破三房谋
lines: 玄水灵泉汩汩流转，温润莹白的灵气裹挟水木精华，源源不断涌入泉中少年体内。
沈砚盘膝端坐泉眼正中，双目轻闭，心神内守丹田气海。
方才冲破境界壁垒，一举踏入武徒一重，丹田新生的气海尚且浅薄细碎，灵气驳杂不稳，若是仓促离泉，日后修行极易留下隐患，根基虚浮、进阶滞涩。
寻常武者借外力突破，大多急于求成，破境之后便即刻离去，贪图境界跃升的战力优越感，往往舍弃稳固根基的最佳时机。
可沈砚历经无数绝境沉浮，深谙武道根基大于一切的道理。
淬体境数日连破数重，已然堪称逆天，若是武徒初境根基不稳，后续对上侯府嫡系武徒修士，必将处处受制、战力折损。他坐拥整片灵泉灵气，坐拥碧鳞蛟一身精纯底蕴，自要将武徒一重根基打磨至同阶极致，做到同境无敌、越级可战。
心念既定，沈砚彻底放空杂念，全身心投入稳境修行之中。
周身毛孔尽数舒张，周遭浓稠如水雾的灵泉灵气顺着肌理经脉，有序汇入丹田气海，驳杂灵气逐层提纯、去芜存菁，一点点扩充气海容积、凝练灵力质感。
与此同时，先前鏖战碧鳞蛟留存体内的蛟兽精血，也顺着经脉缓缓游走周身。
不同于野狼、鬃狮的野性精血，碧鳞蛟身为半步武徒顶尖妖兽，常年吸纳灵泉天地灵气，精血自带温润灵性，不含暴戾煞气，既能滋养气海灵力，又能重塑肉身肌理，拔高肉身上限。
一灵一刚，灵气塑武道气海，精血锻凡俗肉身，双向相辅相成。
时间一点一滴流逝，盆地之内灵雾翻涌，以灵泉为中心，形成肉眼可见的灵气气旋，环绕沈砚周身盘旋不息。
外界天色几经更迭，从破晓晨光，到日中烈日，再到夕阳西斜。
整整一日一夜的泉底稳修，悄然落幕。
嗡。
一声细微灵气震颤自体内响起，沈砚长长吐出一口灰白浊气，浊气落地便被灵气消解无踪。
他缓缓抬眸，眸底无凌厉锋芒，只剩澄澈厚重，眼底深处藏着一缕莹白灵力微光，收放自如、内敛无痕。
武徒一重，根基圆满！
此刻他丹田气海宽阔凝练，灵力醇厚无瑕，肉身经由蛟血、灵泉双重淬炼，早已彻底剥离凡人筋骨，皮肉自带灵力防护，寻常淬体九重兵刃，已然难以割裂他的肌肤。
抬手之间，便可引动天地灵气，一念聚力，便可灵力附拳，战力相较半步武徒时期，暴涨三倍有余。
“这便是正统武道之力，远超淬体蛮力。”
沈砚抬手凝视掌心，一缕淡白色灵力缓缓流转，触感温润却蕴藏破碎山石之威。
淬体，炼血肉气力；武徒，御天地灵气。二者本质天差地别，不可同日而语。
先前那八名三房精锐死士，两名淬体九重、六名八重巅峰，联手便可碾压青阳城大半散修，可如今在他眼中，不过是随手可灭的蝼蚁，连让他动用灵力的资格都没有。
柳氏倚仗多年的武道势力、三房培养的淬体死士，自此，再无半分威胁。
沈砚起身，脚步轻踏，身形径直浮出灵泉水面，衣衫沾水却不染湿气，周身灵力自发流转，顷刻间烘干衣料，身姿挺拔落至岸边青石之上。
目光落向一旁静静漂浮的碧鳞蛟尸身，眸色微动。
斩杀此蛟，夺得灵泉，助力自身突破武徒，这头古林霸主，价值远不止于此。
沈砚缓步上前，指尖灵力凝聚，化作锋利刃气，轻轻划开蛟兽头颅软组织。
青光迸发，一颗鸽卵大小、通体剔透碧绿、内里灵气流转的圆珠，静静卧于蛟兽颅腔之中，温润灵气四散扩散，质感厚重纯净。
蛟珠！
妖兽修为抵达半步武徒之上，灵智开化、灵气聚核，体内便可凝结兽珠，等同于人类武者的气海核心。
这颗碧鳞蛟凝结的蛟珠，吸纳数十年灵泉精华，价值堪比上品淬体丹药，既可直接炼化增幅灵力，亦可交由炼器师淬炼，打造灵力护身法器。
放眼整个镇北侯府，嫡系子弟手中，都极少有品相如此上乘的兽珠。
沈砚指尖一勾，灵力牵引，将蛟珠取入掌心，触手温润微凉，精纯灵气顺着指尖直入经脉，滋养气海。
“当下不宜就地炼化，带回侯府，寻僻静密室，稳妥炼化。”
沈砚心念笃定，将蛟珠贴身收好，又取下蛟兽周身鳞甲、锋利蛟爪，尽数收纳。琉璃蛟鳞坚硬抗劲，可缝制内甲，蛟爪锋利带灵，可做近身杀伐利器，皆是不可多得的修行物资。
搜刮完一身机缘，沈砚回望整座灵泉盆地。
灵泉依旧灵气蒸腾，此地乃是绝佳苦修之地，只是眼下，他已无心久留。
离开镇北侯府、踏入黑风古林历练，已足足三日之久。
三日时间，府外截杀、山林围剿、秘境血战、破境武徒，世事更迭，修为跃迁。侯府之内柳氏掌权，心思阴狠多疑，三日找不到他的踪迹，必然早已掀起风浪，对他留在府中的居所、为数不多亲近之人下手。
他可以无惧自身生死凶险，却不能放任旁人，借他之名，欺压牵连之人。
content_en:
The Xuanshui Spiritual Spring is gurgling, and the warm and crystal-white spiritual energy is enveloping the essence of water and wood, and is continuously pouring into the body of the young man in the spring.
Shen Yan sat cross-legged in the middle of the spring, with his eyes lightly closed, and his mind guarding the sea of ​​qi in his Dantian.
I have just broken through the realm barrier and stepped into the first level of martial arts. The new Qi sea in my Dantian is still shallow and fragmented, and the spiritual energy is mixed and unstable. If I leave the spring in a hurry, my future practice will easily leave hidden dangers, with a weak foundation and stagnant progress.
Ordinary warriors rely on external forces to break through. Most of them are eager for success and leave immediately after breaking through. Coveting the sense of superiority in combat power as their realms rise, they often abandon the best opportunity to consolidate their foundation.
But Shen Yan has experienced countless desperate situations and understands that the foundation of martial arts is greater than anything else.
Breaking through several levels of the Body Tempering Realm in a few days is already unparalleled. If the foundation of the martial arts apprentice in the initial realm is not stable, then he will be restrained in every way and his combat power will be reduced when he confronts the direct disciples and monks of the Hou Mansion. He has the aura of the entire spiritual spring and the pure foundation of the Jade Scale Jiao. He wants to polish the foundation of the first level of martial arts to the extreme of the same level, so that he can be invincible in the same realm and can fight at higher levels.
With his mind set, Shen Yan completely let go of distracting thoughts and devoted himself wholeheartedly to practicing in a stable state.
The pores all over the body are dilated, and the thick mist-like spirit spring spirit energy around the body flows along the skin and meridians, and flows into the Dantian Qi sea in an orderly manner.
At the same time, the essence and blood of the dragon beast that had been retained in the body during the fierce battle with the green-scaled dragon also slowly traveled around the body along the meridians.
Different from the wild essence and blood of wild wolves and maned lions, the jade-scaled dragon, as the top demon beast of a half-step martial artist, absorbs the spiritual energy of the world and the spiritual spring all year round.
One spirit and one strength, the spiritual energy shapes the sea of ​​martial arts, and the essence and blood forge the mortal body, complementing each other in both directions.
As time passed bit by bit, the spiritual mist surged in the basin, with the spiritual spring as the center, forming a spiritual energy cyclone visible to the naked eye, circling around Shen Yan's body.
The weather outside has changed several times, from the early morning light, to the scorching sun at midday, to the setting sun.
The whole day and night of steady cultivation at the bottom of the spring ended quietly.
Buzz.
A subtle tremor of spiritual energy sounded from within his body, and Shen Yan exhaled a long breath of gray-white turbid air. The turbid air was dissipated by the spiritual energy as soon as it hit the ground.
He slowly raised his eyes. There was no sharp edge in his eyes, only clear and thick. There was a glimmer of white spiritual power hidden deep in his eyes, which could be relaxed and restrained without any trace.
The first level of martial arts, the foundation is perfect!
At this moment, his Dantian Qi sea is broad and concise, and his spiritual power is mellow and flawless. His body has been tempered by the dragon's blood and spiritual springs, and has already been completely stripped of mortal sinews and bones. His skin and flesh are protected by spiritual power. Ordinary nine-layer body-tempering weapons are no longer able to cut his skin.
By raising his hand, he can activate the spiritual energy of heaven and earth. With a single thought, he can attach his spiritual power to his fists. His combat power has increased by more than three times compared to the period when he was a half-step warrior.
"This is the power of orthodox martial arts, which far exceeds the brute force of tempered bodies."
Shen Yan raised his hand and stared at the palm of his hand. A wisp of pale white spiritual power slowly flowed. It felt warm but contained the power of broken rocks.
Tempering the body, refining the strength of flesh and blood; warrior, controlling the spiritual energy of heaven and earth. The two are fundamentally different in nature and cannot be compared.
Previously, the eight three-room elite dead warriors, two ninth-level body tempering warriors, and six eighth-level peak warriors, could crush most of the casual cultivators in Qingyang City together, but now in his eyes, they were just ants that could be destroyed easily, and they were not even qualified to use their spiritual power.
The Liu family relied on years of martial arts power and the body-tempering dead warriors trained by Sanfang. From then on, there was no threat at all.
Shen Yan stood up, stepped lightly, and his figure emerged directly from the water of the spiritual spring. His clothes were stained with water but not damp. The spiritual power around his body flowed spontaneously, drying the clothes in an instant, and his tall figure fell onto the bluestone on the shore.
His gaze fell on the green-scaled dragon corpse floating quietly aside, and his eyes moved slightly.
Kill this dragon, seize the spiritual spring, and help you break through the martial arts. This ancient forest overlord is worth much more than that.
Shen Yan stepped forward slowly, his fingertips gathered spiritual power and turned into sharp blade energy, gently cutting open the soft tissue of the dragon beast's head.
Green light burst out, and a bead the size of a dove egg, completely clear and green, with spiritual energy flowing inside, lay quietly in the skull cavity of the dragon beast. The warm spiritual energy spread in all directions, and its texture was thick and pure.
Dragon beads!
When the cultivation level of the monster beast reaches above that of a half-step warrior, the spiritual wisdom is enlightened and the spiritual energy is gathered, the beast beads can be condensed in the body, which is equivalent to the core of the sea of ​​​​qi of a human warrior.
This jade-scaled dragon bead has absorbed the essence of decades of spiritual springs and is as valuable as a top-grade body-tempering elixir. It can be directly refined to increase spiritual power, or it can be tempered by a weapon refiner to create a spiritual protective weapon.
Looking at the entire Zhenbei Hou Mansion, there are very few beast beads of such high quality in the hands of the direct descendants.
Shen Yan hooked his fingertips, and with the help of spiritual power, he took the dragon bead into the palm of his hand. The tentacles were warm and slightly cool, and the pure spiritual energy flowed directly into the meridians along the fingertips, nourishing the sea of ​​qi.
"It is not appropriate to refine it on the spot right now. Take it back to the Marquis Mansion and find a secluded secret room to refine it safely."
Shen Yan thought carefully and put the dragon beads close to his body. He also took off the scales and sharp claws from the dragon beast's body and stored them all. The scales of the glazed dragon are hard and resistant, and can be used to sew inner armor. The claws of the dragon are sharp and spiritual, and can be used as weapons for close combat. They are all rare cultivation materials.
After searching for opportunities, Shen Yan looked back at the entire Lingquan Basin.
The spiritual spring is still steaming with spiritual energy. This place is an excellent place for self-cultivation, but right now, he has no intention of staying for a long time.
It has been three days since I left the Zhenbei Hou Mansion and entered the Black Wind Ancient Forest for training.
In three days, there were interceptions outside the mansion, sieges in the mountains and forests, bloody battles in secret realms, and warriors breaking through realms. Things in the world changed and their cultivation level leapt. The Liu family was in power in the Hou Mansion, and they were vicious and suspicious. No trace of him could be found for three days, so a storm must have been stirred up, and the few people close to him who stayed in the manor were targeted.
He can fear the danger of his own life and death, but he cannot let others use his name to oppress those involved.
title_en: Chapter 19: Training with dragon beads and bringing Wu Guifu to the forefront Chapter 20: Wu deterred everyone and revealed the conspiracy of the three houses
